6923.d: The cosmic altar is a runecrafting altar located in the Cosmic Rune Temple, which is used to craft cosmic runes from pure essence with the Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the cosmic rift in the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A cosmic talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A cosmic tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A cosmic talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a cosmic altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use any fairy ring or a portable fairy ring to teleport to Zanaris and go south to the ruins. There are jutting walls that can be traversed with level 46 or 66 Agility to get to the ruins faster.

7014.d: The Crafting Guild is located south-west of Falador and north of Rimmington.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are several methods of reaching the Crafting Guild. In addition to walking to the guild, players may use the following transportation methods:
• A skills necklace or modified artisan's bandana can be used to teleport to the Crafting Guild.
• Teleporting to the Port Sarim lodestone and running north-west.
• Teleporting to the Rimmington player-owned house portal.
• Members who have unlocked the Crafting Guild hot air balloon route after completing Enlightened Journey can take a hot air balloon to just north of the Crafting Guild for a fee of two charges.

7019.d: The Crafting Guild Mine is a mine inside the Crafting Guild, which is only accessible to players with at least level 40 Crafting.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• A skills necklace can teleport the player to directly outside the guild.
• House Teleport set to Rimmington, then go north.
• Explorer's ring 3 or 4 can teleport players to the Falador farm. From here, they can walk west along the road to the guild.
• Use the Port Sarim lodestone and go north-west.
• Members who have completed the Enlightened Journey quest and unlock related destination, can use the balloon transport system from the Castle Wars bank chest, paying 2 charges to fly to the Crafting Guild entrance.

7048.d: Crash Island is a small island to the east of Ape Atoll.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are two ways to get to Crash Island:
• Waydar in Tree Gnome Stronghold's secret hangar will take you there:
• Talk to Daero on the floor 2 of the Grand Tree, near Blurberry's bar. He will blindfold you and take you to an underground hangar where you will find Waydar, who will fly you to Crash Island.
• Lumdo via Ape Atoll (Ape Atoll Teleport)

Lumdo and Waydar remain on the island after the quest, and they can transport the player to Ape Atoll and Tree Gnome Stronghold, respectively.
